name: Tile Console
author: Minty
summary: Adds a 'tile' console command to modify, recolor or crumble a tile, a row, a column, or the whole board.
description: A console utility, not a gambit. Open the in-game console and run `tile <where> <what>`: `<where>` is `all`, a row (1-5), a column (a-h) or a single coordinate like `d3`; `<what>` is a tile modifier (golden, protective, blessing, trap, phantom, cursed), a color (white, black), `crumble`, or `default` to reset the tile and bring a crumbled one back. Turn on the game's tile-coordinate overlay in settings to see which square is which. Handy for testing gambits and setting up board states.
